dialogues.text_zh: 欸？被、被發現了……那、魔王大人……其實……距離表演還很久的……

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: Then, before the show starts, I'll fill you with even more courage.
dialogues.text_zh: 那麼，我會在表演開始前，為妳灌注更多勇氣。

role_voices.text_zh: 你好！我是魔術師「魔幻香草」，歡迎來欣賞我的表演喲！
role_voices.text_en: Hello! I'm the magician "Magical Vanilla." Please enjoy my show!

role_voices.text_zh: 魔術師禮帽裡總是會跳出兔子……但是誰說，不能跳出魔術師本人呢？
role_voices.text_en: A rabbit always jumps out of a magician's top hat... but who's to say the magician can't be the one to pop out for a change?

role_voices.text_zh: 香草冰淇淋——！唔嗯嗯——！真好吃啊……不愧是永遠的經典。
role_voices.text_en: Vanilla ice cream—! Mmm—! It's so delicious... Truly a timeless classic.

role_voices.text_zh: 「魔幻香草」是奧茲幫我想的喔，因為我的魔術有不少是從經典魔術改編來的。
role_voices.text_en: Magical Vanilla is a name Oz came up with for me, since a lot of my magic tricks are adaptations of classic routines.

role_voices.text_zh: 芙蕾雅小姐之前說要借我幾顆寶石，增加表演的華麗度。但那實在太珍貴了……我不敢用！
role_voices.text_en: Miss Freya offered to lend me a few jewels to make my performance more glamorous, but they're just too precious… I was too nervous to use them!

role_voices.text_zh: 玉兔小姐說要變成兔子跟我一起表演，因為她是一隻聽得懂人話的兔子，所以超好配合的！
role_voices.text_en: Miss Jade Rabbit said she'd turn into a rabbit and perform with me, and since she's a rabbit who can understand what I say, she's super easy to work with!

role_voices.text_zh: 豆芽菜營養又經濟實惠，非常讚呢。話說魔王大人，你知道其實豆芽菜超好種的嗎？
role_voices.text_en: Bean sprouts are nutritious and affordable—they're really great. By the way, Lord Archfiend, did you know that bean sprouts are actually super easy to grow?

role_voices.text_zh: 小奧茲～唔姆姆姆——好可愛喲！咦？魔王大人，你也想要體驗一下小奧茲的感覺？！
role_voices.text_en: Little Oz~ mmm, so adorable! Huh? Lord Archfiend, do you want to experience what it's like to be Little Oz too?!

role_voices.text_zh: 魔王大人？嗯嗯♥等等，這裡可是簽名會會場——哈嗯♥♥等等、先等一下啦♥
role_voices.text_en: Lord Archfiend? Mmm♥ W-Wait, we're at a fan signing event—hahn♥♥ Wait, j-just hold on a second♥

role_voices.text_zh: 今天是……草莓冰淇淋吃到飽！
role_voices.text_en: Today's special is... all-you-can-eat strawberry ice cream!

role_voices.text_zh: 魔術師的帽子，是夢想，也是奇蹟！
role_voices.text_en: A magician's hat is both a dream and a miracle!

role_voices.text_zh: 今天的壓軸好戲要開始囉！
role_voices.text_en: Tonight's grand finale is about to begin!

role_voices.text_zh: 兔女郎出現在帽子裡，一點都不奇怪吧！
role_voices.text_en: It's not strange at all for a bunny girl to pop out of a hat!

role_voices.text_zh: 不行……不能讓父母傷心……我一定要活下去……！
role_voices.text_en: No... I can't let my parents down... I have to survive...!

role_voices.text_zh: 魔術秀到此結束～謝謝大家的捧場！
role_voices.text_en: The magic show is now over~ Thanks for coming, everyone!
